title: Revisiting near-extremal and near-BPS black holes in AdS3 supergravity
summary: Despite the archetypal status of the BTZ background in quantifying quantum aspects of black holes, several features at low temperatures remain imprecise and incomplete. Here, we systematically investigate the behaviour of the Euclidean path integral at low temperatures in the context of AdS3 supergravity, including an analysis of quantum fluctuations in both the near-horizon and asymptotic regions.
